subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female doctor from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the male patient from <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the clinic consultation-room environment from <Picture 3>.
@
summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a short humorous clinic exchange set in <Subject 3>, where <Subject 1> consults <Subject 2> and they trade a brief comic back-and-forth about his exaggerated symptoms, using the three reference images only as appearance and setting guidance.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the female doctor's identity and role from <Picture 1> are retained as the consulting physician.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the male patient's identity and role from <Picture 2> are retained as the seated patient.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the clinic room layout and atmosphere from <Picture 3> are retained as the continuous setting.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a clean, bright medical-sitcom style with soft overhead clinic lighting and a lightly desaturated palette.
[Shot 1] A medium two-shot opens inside <Subject 3>, the clinic consultation room. <Subject 1>, the female doctor, sits behind the desk facing camera-right, holding a pen above a chart. Across from her, <Subject 2>, the male patient, sits slightly slumped in the visitor chair. <Subject 1> (S1) looks up with a practiced calm smile and asks evenly, <d>[Chinese] 哪里不舒服？</d> <Subject 2> (S2) straightens, clears his throat with mock gravity, and replies, <d>[Chinese] 医生，我最近总觉得自己是个手机——整天被摸来摸去，还动不动就没电。</d> He mimes a drained battery with a limp wrist. <Subject 1> (S1) pauses, then raises one eyebrow without breaking professional composure.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.500, the shot tightens to a medium close-up favoring <Subject 1> (S1) as she leans a fraction forward, still framed against <Subject 3>. She taps the pen once on the chart and answers dryly, <d>[Chinese] 那您先打开飞行模式，我们慢慢看——顺便问一句，您现在是几格信号？</d> <Subject 2> (S2), still partly visible at frame edge, lets out a short surprised laugh and holds up two fingers like signal bars. <Subject 1> (S1) allows a small amused smile, then returns to writing on the chart as the beat lands.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet clinic room tone with a faint HVAC hum and soft paper-and-pen rustle continues throughout; no external corridor noise.

non_diegetic_music:
A light, understated pizzicato-strings sitcom cue at a moderate tempo, staying low under the dialogue and ending with a brief playful sting after the final line.
